name: Japan
description: Japan combines cutting-edge research facilities with deep cultural heritage, offering fully funded government scholarships such as MEXT for students at every degree level.

name: Germany
description: Germany is home to tuition-free public universities and generous DAAD scholarships, making it one of the most affordable study destinations for international students.

name: United Kingdom
description: The UK hosts world-renowned institutions and flagship awards like Chevening, which fully fund one-year master's degrees for future global leaders.

name: United States
description: The United States offers prestigious fully funded programs such as the Fulbright Foreign Student Program across thousands of accredited universities.

name: Australia
description: Australia Awards and university-specific scholarships give international students access to a high quality of life alongside globally ranked universities.

name: South Korea
description: South Korea's Global Korea Scholarship (KGSP) fully funds tuition, living costs, and Korean language training for undergraduate and graduate students.

name: Canada
description: Canada pairs a welcoming immigration pathway with elite doctoral funding like the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships.

name: China
description: The Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) opens the door to fast-growing universities with full tuition, housing, and stipend coverage.

name: Netherlands
description: The Netherlands offers English-taught programs and targeted awards such as the Orange Tulip Scholarship for students from partner countries.

name: Sweden
description: The Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals fund master's students committed to future leadership and sustainability.
